issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'sáu trăm sáu mươi sáu ta-lâng vàng' (666 talents of gold), but the Vietnamese says 'sáu trăm sáu mươi sáu vạn cân vàng' (666 ten-thousand catties), which changes the unit of measure from 'talents' (kikkar) to 'vạn cân' (ten-thousand catties), a different and inaccurate quantity.
